approach: Fix the omission where it starts: the producer brief only carries prior findings in the seeded path, and carries the whole unlabelled list there. Add one shared helper in reading.rs that formats a finding and picks the blocker and major ones of the previous attempt's final verification (no resolved state). Use it for both paths. Seeded: TreeRetrySeed and RetrySeed gain a must_address list, shown in a "Findings you must address" block above the full finding list. Unseeded (no tree seed, no resume): a new retry_findings lookup feeds a new ProducerInputs field, rendered by the same briefs.rs function. Separately: IntrospectionRecord gets a planning_stopped marker set from the outcome reason prefix, IntrospectionJev gets a context_prevention field (outcome from a fixed list, or an error), Jev's call gets a third, optional question, and jev.rs parse_response tolerates a missing or wrongly typed answer for that optional key only. Then docs, D130 and CHANGELOG.

decisions.choice: Carry every blocker and major finding of the retried job's final verification; invent no resolved state.
decisions.reason: Finding (records.rs:750) has no resolved flag. verify::finding_blocks already defines blocking as Blocker or Major; reuse it.

rejected.option: Add a resolved flag on Finding
rejected.why: Out of scope, and nothing would set it.
Guesswork; dropping a real finding is the failure being fixed.

decisions.choice: One shared finding formatter and blocking selector in reading.rs, used by carry, tree_retry_seed and the new retry_findings. One shared renderer in briefs.rs for both paths.
decisions.reason: Gives 'listed the same way' by construction. The three formatters are copies today (carry, tree_retry_seed and the critique code), which is how paths drift.

rejected.why: Leaves the seeded list unlabelled and the copies divergent; treats the instance, not the root cause.

rejected.option: Label by matching the 'blocker'/'major' text prefix in briefs.rs
rejected.why: Fragile string parsing; select by Severity in reading.rs instead.

decisions.choice: Keep the seeded full finding list and add a separate labelled must-address block.
decisions.reason: Keeps the minor findings visible as before and tells the producer which findings must be addressed, in both paths.

rejected.option: Replace the full list with blocker and major only
rejected.why: Loses information the seeded retry already had.

decisions.choice: In parse_response, a missing answer, or one of the wrong type, fails the whole reply only for required questions. A const OPTIONAL_QUESTIONS in jev.rs names the context-prevention key. ask_jev checks that answer itself.
decisions.reason: The real parser fails the whole reply on any missing answer, so a plain third question would make older or partial replies discard the class and repeat answers. A const avoids a serde-visible field on Question.

rejected.option: Add an optional flag to Question
rejected.why: Changes every Question literal and the wire shape unless serde-skipped; larger than needed.
The real parser would still fail; the brief names the real parser.

decisions.choice: Store the post-mortem in IntrospectionJev as context_prevention: Option<{outcome, error}>. Fixed list: system-facts-line, failure-class, brief-assembly, vocabulary-term, spec-fix, structure, none. A missing answer gives None. A wrong type or out-of-list choice gives error text and no outcome. validate() accepts it.
decisions.reason: The question is put to Jev, in shadow, so its answer lives beside Jev's other answers. An error in the field blocks nothing, and a failed whole call leaves it None.

rejected.option: Ask the language model as well
rejected.why: The request puts the question in Jev's call; a second source is not asked for.

decisions.choice: Add planning_stopped: bool to IntrospectionRecord, serde default and skipped when false, set in event_of_job/introspect from outcome.reason starting 'planning stopped before any code was written:' (the prefix run.rs:553 writes). Carry it on Event.
decisions.reason: Records the fact in a typed field. The prefix is a constant written by one function; make it a pub const in athena-data or core and use it in both places.

rejected.why: Category is documented as rejected or failed and may be read elsewhere.
Flags mean problems found in the model's answer.

risks.risk: Adding fields to IntrospectionRecord and IntrospectionJev breaks struct literals in files outside the deliverable list.
risks.mitigation: Both new fields are listed with the files; the edits are mechanical, and the compiler finds any miss. Serde default and skip-when-empty keep old records parsing under deny_unknown_fields.

risks.mitigation: Update that assertion. The optional question degrades safely through the parse_response tolerance.

demonstrations.method: Unit test in reading.rs tests: a job with two major findings (summary, evidence, location) and one minor, with locations in docs/ so tree_retry_seed qualifies. Build the producer brief through the seeded path (tree_retry_seed → RetrySeed → producer_brief) and the unseeded path (retry_findings → producer_brief). Assert both majors appear in each brief inside the 'must address' block, in identical lines, and the minor is absent from that block.
demonstrations.observes: Both briefs list both majors with summary, evidence and location in the same format; the minor is not in the must-address block.
demonstrations.fails_without: If either builder dropped a major finding, or the unseeded brief carried none (current behaviour), the assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Unit test in jev.rs tests calling the real parse_response with the three-question set and a body that answers only the class and repeat questions. Also cases for a boolean answer to the context choice question and an out-of-list choice, passed on to ask_jev through an Evaluate stub that returns the parsed result.
demonstrations.observes: Parse returns Ok with class and repeat answers; the context field is None. The wrong-typed and out-of-list answers give an error string in context_prevention and class and repeat are still stored; the Evaluation is not discarded.
demonstrations.fails_without: With the old parse_response, the missing answer returns JevError::Malformed and the class and repeat answers are lost.

demonstrations.method: Tests in crates/athena-cli/tests/introspection.rs through run_job and athena.introspect_job: (a) a job failed by stop_planning (planning enabled, critic rejecting) with FakeJev answering a list item gives planning_stopped true and the outcome in context_prevention; (b) a rejected job and a failed job (rustfmt.toml edit) give the field and planning_stopped false; (c) a landed job gives no record; (d) a Jev Err leaves the job's outcome state unchanged and the field None.
demonstrations.observes: The record has the marker and a context outcome in the fixed list. Non-planning jobs have the field and no marker. No record for a landed job. The outcome state is unchanged when Jev errors.
demonstrations.fails_without: No marker is set and no field exists; the assertions on planning_stopped and context_prevention fail.

demonstrations.method: Test in introspection.rs (and a unit test in introspect.rs): capture FakeJev calls; assert the question set contains the key whose instructions contain 'What one piece of context, if the agent had read it, would have prevented this?' and a Choice whose criteria keys are exactly the seven list items. Then write a record carrying the field, commit and reload it with AnyRecord::parse, and compare equal.
demonstrations.observes: The instruction text and all seven options are in the sent call. The reloaded record equals the written one and carries the field.
demonstrations.fails_without: The call lacks the question, or deny_unknown_fields rejects the stored field on read.
